annotations.title: Set a Page's DM entry points

description:
[PUBLISHES to social accounts · `publish` scope] Changes what EVERY visitor sees when they open a DM with the account; only the fields you pass change, null or [] removes one. Instagram takes iceBreakers only (question text, up to 4); a Facebook Page also takes greeting, menuLinks ({title, https url}) and getStarted. If `foreignPayloads` from get_dm_entry_points is not empty, setting iceBreakers replaces entry points made outside flayr: say so. Show the user the exact text and confirm before calling.
(Wraps PUT /api/v2/accounts/{id}/entry-points.)

brandId.description: An id from GET /api/v2/brands, or "personal". Omitted → the key's bound brand, else the owner's personal accounts.

getStarted.description: Facebook only. Show the Get Started button.

greeting.description: Facebook only. The welcome text shown before the first message (up to 160 characters).

iceBreakers.description: Up to 4 questions (up to 80 characters each), in order.

id.description: An Instagram or Facebook account id from GET /api/v2/accounts.

menuLinks.description: Facebook only. The persistent menu, web links only.

title.description: Button title (up to 30 characters, or the configured limit).

url.description: An https:// link: the site, a booking page, a shop.

name: set_dm_entry_points
title: Set a Page's DM entry points
